name: AI Product Experience Employer Seeds
description: CURATED MARKET INTELLIGENCE — not automated market coverage. A human-reviewed list of employers judged relevant enough to AI Product Experience that Job Finder should deliberately monitor them. It is a deliberate substitute for automated discovery, which DE-2B established is not achievable from free, structured, lawful sources for emerging AI-product companies. It must never be presented as discovered market coverage, and must always be shown with its lastReviewedAt date.
curationMethod: Inclusion requires at least one of: principal product is AI-native; product fundamentally depends on generative AI, agents, conversational AI or human-AI interaction; company publicly describes an AI-native end-user product; observed product/experience design hiring for AI work. Excluded: traditional companies adding generic AI features, AI consultancies, research-only organisations, infrastructure without a user-facing experience layer, and any company included solely because a benchmark contained it. HIGH = AI-design hiring directly observed on a live posting. MEDIUM = AI-native product verified from the company's official site, design hiring not observed. WATCH = qualifies on product but hiring cadence unproven or evidence incomplete.
reviewCadence: Quarterly. Any entry unreviewed for two cadences is demoted to WATCH rather than trusted.
